jobs.title: Learning Operations Manager - Walton, KY
jobs.description:
﻿

The Learning Operations Manager influences with a focus on safety, leadership, excellence, self-motivation, problem-solving and teamwork. This role will enable employees to develop the knowledge, skill, behaviors and experience they need to achieve their goals and progress their career. Partner with DC operations and our Learning & Development team to deliver results. This role will be responsible for facilitating training programs while coaching and holding your operational-leader partners accountable for their success.

Job Responsibility
• Acts as an engaging and inclusive leader who will develop and implement training content for the assigned DC. (35%)
• Communicates and oversees the execution of training at all levels by DC, maintaining strategic partnerships with the entire DC, other DCs and various SSC partners. (20%)
• Creates strategies to balance short- and long-term business plans. (10%)
• Fosters the development and growth of employees and leaders in assigned DC. (10%)
• Works closely with the SSC’s Learning & Development team and the Human Resources teams to ensure standard training programs are properly designed and consistently implemented (5%)
• Selects, evaluates, and develops Training Coordinators (5%)
• Coaches managers on developing leadership skills in their supervisors. (5%)
• Assists DC management with organizational development plans. (5%)
• Analyzes and understands data to measure the training program performance within the DC. (5%)

Job Qualifications
• Thorough working knowledge of distribution center
• Good reasoning, conflict-management, and analytical and problem-solving skills
• Understanding of training design and needs analysis
• Understanding of performance development, team development, and leadership development processes; demonstrated developmental approach to leadership
• Ability to evaluate supervisory and management employees for leadership potential
• Excellent interpersonal, organizational and communication skills with all levels of the organization
• Able to read and interpret necessary policies and procedures to perform updates and operate systems and other programs within the Distribution Center.

Education/Experience
• Bachelor’s degree in education or human resource development preferred.
• Two to four years' experience in employee training and development or in a human resources position with employee development emphasis.


Drives employee development by facilitating training programs and coaching operational leaders to ensure success. Partners with distribution center operations and Learning & Development teams to build skills, foster leadership, and promote a culture of safety and excellence.

jobs.title: Process Improvement Manager - Corp
jobs.description:
Job Details Duties & Responsibilities:
- Lead and support key cross functional and strategic projects using structured project management methodologies that deliver significant value to Dollar General.
Define project scope, timelines, milestones, resources, and success metrics. Ensure alignment with business priorities and track progress against established plans.
- Apply formal project management practices, including project planning, status reporting, risk management, and stakeholder communication.
Maintain clear documentation and ensure consistent execution standards across projects.
- Rigorously support the identification, evaluation, implementation and execution of processes that improve the efficiency and effectiveness of Dollar General.
Support strategic planning, process review and improvement projects to enhance corporate performance.
- Analyze processes and performance through data collection, time studies, and productivity assessments.
Identify root causes, evaluate improvement opportunities, and recommend actionable solutions to optimize performance.
- Partner with Supply Chain, Store Operations, Merchandising and other department leadership in the development and deployment of process improvement initiatives.
Work with IT, Finance, and other support functions to remove constraints, justify investments and implement solutions that improve service and reduce expense.Knowledge, Skills and Abilities (KSAs):
- Ability to quickly identify potential drivers of emerging problems, root cause, and generate solutions.

- Ability to partner, coordinate and influence across all levels of management.

- Ability to prioritize projects based on solution impact, time to implement and/or direction from leadership.

- Ability to lead multiple priorities and projects (3-5).

- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills across all levels of the organization.

- Design and execute appropriate analyses to size potential impact of problems or solutions.

- Strong analytical and process mapping skills.

- Knowledge of project management methodologies.

- Ability to create and execute an implementation plan for rollout.

Job Qualifications

Work Experience &/or Education:
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain or Industrial Engineering required, or equivalent professional experience.

- Advanced Degree preferred.

- Minimum of 5 years of relevant work experience.

- Project Management (PMP Certification), Industrial engineering, Six Sigma, and/or Lean Six Sigma experience preferred.

jobs.title: STORE OPERATIONS MANAGER
jobs.description:
﻿

Owns and/or delivers financial/operational analysis on store operations projects. This may include regular weekly and monthly reporting, metric trending, data mining and development of business cases, and associated benefits. Additionally, assists with ad hoc analyses and support of other projects and departments as requested.

Job Responsibility
Analytics and Reporting (50%)
• Leverages multiple internal systems to perform detailed analyses, identify trends or expectations, and support issue resolution.
• Designs, maintains, and manages reporting scorecards that track operations metrics, task management performance, and communication tool adoption for leadership review.
• Conducts process and applications audits; builds measurement tools to analyze current processes and recommend improvements or new solutions.
• Identifies and pursues process improvement opportunities with a focus on reducing waste and enabling automation.

Project Management (30%)
• Develops and manages project plans to monitor progress and status updates for key projects and test-and-learn initiatives.
• Captures detailed requirements for enhancement requires and formalizes documentations for tool and process development or optimization.
• Performs field observations to gather insights support process mapping, and assess the impact of process changes.

Communication (20%)
• Develops presentations, communications, and training materials for leadership updates, product enhancement rollout, cross-functional initiatives, and training sessions.
• Provides field support through diagnostic troubleshooting for software applications and oversees user access management for internal tool.

Job Qualifications
• Demonstrates a knowledge of retail operations, merchandising and financial software and databases.
• Strong analytical, problem solving, and decision-making skills with an ability to meet deadlines.
• Familiar with reading, writing, and editing programming languages such as SQL, XML, and Visual Basic.
• Experience with data mining and database management tool like PowerPivot, Power Quiery, Alteryx, and/or 1010data to identify opportunities through root cause analysis, develop actionable solutions and reports, and execute required plans.
• Highly proficient at MS Office products, especially PowerPoint, Excel, Teams, SharePoint, and Outlook.
• Familiar with reading, writing, and editing programming languages such as SQL, XML, and Visual Basic.
• Strong written and oral communication skills with the ability to summarize data into reports and presentations for senior leadership

Education/Experience
Bachelor’s degree required with a 4-6 years of experience minimum of 2 – 4 years of work experience in an analyst role. Master’s degree in Business preferred. Retail work experience a plus.

jobs.title: Digital Analytics Manager
jobs.description:
Deliver analytics and insights to drive increased engagement, adoption, and retention across all digital platforms, digital tools and services to grow myDG Delivery. Help evaluate new/emerging digital engagement opportunities aimed at creating strategic advantages for Dollar General’s digital platforms. Be the advocate for digital data integrity, partnering closely with I.T./outside contractors. Also partners with the Digital Product team on Digital Coupons and Offers Gallery, Loyalty, Subscription and more to ensure digital engagement & ecommerce data integrity are a top priority.
Job Responsibility
- Analyze ecommerce performance and delivery actionable insights – monitor KPI’s conversional funnel performance, customer behavior, revenue trends, and product/category performance to identify growth opportunities and revenue targets. (25%)
- Develop reporting, dashboards, and measurement strategies – Build and maintain executive dashboards, KPI frameworks, recurring reporting, and analytics solutions that enable data driven decision-making across ecommerce, site merchandising, DGMN and marketing.    (20%)
- Drive conversion optimization and digital experience improvements – Partner with UX, product, and ecommerce teams to identify optimization opportunities, analyze A/B tests, and improve website/app performance. (15%)
- Own analytics implementation and data quality – Manage tracking requirements, analytics tagging, event measurement, data validation, and reporting accuracy in partnership with technology teams. (15%)
- Analyze site merchandising, marketing, and customer performance – Evaluate acquisition channels, digital shelves, landing pages, search conversion, campaigns, customer segments, retention trends, and lifecycle performance to improve customer growth and engagement. (15%)
- Collaborate cross-functionally and communicate insights – Translate complex analytics into clear recommendations for leadership, merchandising, marketing, operations, and product teams. (10%)

Job Qualifications
- Ecommerce analytics and business acumen
- Data analysis and insight generation
- Analytics tools and technical expertise
- Conversion rate optimization and experimentation
- Communication and cross-functional influence

Education/Experience
- 3–5 years of experience in digital analytics, ecommerce analytics, web analytics, product analytics, or marketing analytics
- Experience supporting B2C ecommerce, retail, DTC, marketplace, or omnichannel businesses
- Proven experience analyzing digital customer journeys, conversion funnels, site/app performance, and revenue-driving opportunities
- Experience developing dashboards, reporting frameworks, and KPI measurement strategies
- Experience partnering with ecommerce, marketing, product, UX, merchandising, and technology teams
- Hands-on experience with analytics tools, data visualization platforms, and digital measurement implementations
- Experience with A/B testing, CRO, customer segmentation, and performance optimization preferred
- Bachelor’s degree required

jobs.title: HR Generalist - DC Jonesville
jobs.description:
Job Responsibility

Employee Relations – 35%

- Coordinates and conducts orientation and onboarding program for new hires.

- Promotes open door policy and an environment free of organized labor through effective positive employee relations.

- Plans, manages, and tracks employee recognition and incentive programs.

- Coordinates and leads employee engagement champions to deliver quality and meaningful activities for employees and the community.

- Plans, prepares and maintains employee communication centers utilizing various media such as newsletter, posters, and memorandums.

- Conducts investigations, prepares investigative reports and makes recommendations to resolve employee issues based on policy, past practice and legal justifications.

- Assists supervisors to formulate disciplinary actions.

- Conducts exit interviews and make recommendations based on trends or notable comments for advising management for improvement.

Staffing – 35%

- Plans and coordinates recruitment of non-exempt applicants, develops and recommends recruiting strategies.

- Selects applicants for interviews and provides support for management performing the steps of the interviewing and job offer processes as well as the automated on-boarding process.

- Manages internal job posting process and documentation.

- Partners with contracted agencies to align temporary staffing to meet business needs.

Process Management – 30%

- Responsible for maintaining human resources records and leads clerical staff in records management.

- Prepares various reports from databases and spreadsheets for the reporting of staff management. Maintains budget and expense control.

- Monitors supervisor compliance to record management requirements.

- Audits human resources records to ensure data integrity.

- Maintains leaves of absences at the local level in partnership with third party and Store Support Center (SSC) staff.

- Prepares witness documentation and testifies at unemployment hearings.

- Advises management on legal/policy compliance.

- Maintains non-exempt HR staff time and attendance records. Leads non-exempt HR staff in job duties and projects.

- Recommends and coordinates employee recognition programs and celebrations.

- Assists HR Manager in preparing annual budget and monthly expenditures reports.

- Works days, shifts and hours necessary to accomplish objectives.

- Training - Prepares and facilitates HR leadership training for interviewing, equal employment opportunities, diversity, fair labor standards and internal policies. Manages facility certification programs for hourly and salaried employees, including Performance Management, learning plans and Biz Library participation. Takes lead in preparing and training staff on special projects and pilot programs.

- Compliance - Monitors and recommends actions to comply with state and Federal employment law and Company policy. Provides orientation to new employees regarding required compliance. Maintains employment posters in compliance.

- Safety - Active on safety team and participates in accident reviews. Monitors

compliance with reporting requirements and makes recommendations for corrective actions.

Job Qualifications

- Thorough knowledge of human resource principles and practices including positive employee relations, hiring, training, performance management, and employment law.

- Ability to build effective working relationships at all levels of an organization.

- Skills in researching for legal compliance and analytic ability to formulate best practices.

- Effective oral and written communication skills, and ability to effectively present reports to management.

- Computer skills: Word, Excel, Access, Outlook and HRIS such as Lawson, KRONOS and SharePoint.

Working Conditions

- Exposure to changing climatic conditions and extreme heat and cold.

- Occasionally required to walk long distances within the distribution center.

- Sitting for long periods of time in an office environment.

- Bending, stooping, squatting, or kneeling on a repetitious basis.

- Fast-paced environment.

Education/Experience

- Knowledge and skill are normally acquired through post-secondary education at the bachelor’s level in areas such as human resources management, industrial psychology, and business administration.

- At least three to five years in a progressively responsible human resource generalist position if there is no college degree; or at least three years in a professional or managerial human resources position with a bachelor’s degree.

- Professional human resources certification (or demonstrated progress towards certification) is preferred but not required.

License/Certification Required

N/A


The HR Generalist is responsible for full-service human resources management for both hourly and salaried employees, under the oversight of the Sr. Human Resources Manager for the facility.

jobs.title: Director - Supply Chain HR
jobs.description:
Job Details
Ensures the execution and implementation of the strategy and vision for staffing, training and development, benefits communications, succession planning, employee relations, union avoidance, performance measurement, performance management, and training for distribution center employees. Analyzes, defines and implements DC structure, functions, core competencies, processes and measurements to efficiently and effectively achieve company goals through tough expense control, courageous people development, and effective management practices. Partners with various business functions to drive business objectives, plan and execute strategy, control expenses, and facilitate the alignment of human capital with organizational goals through best practices and supporting policies, resulting in a positive work environment and employer of choice recruitment.

Job Qualifications

- Ensure the execution and implementation of the strategy and vision for staffing, recruiting, internal development, performance management, and employee engagement for assigned distribution centers.

- Manage distribution center employee relations.
May help resolve escalated personnel-related problems and issues.
- Assist with succession planning.
Recruit, select, and assess potential leadership candidates both internally and externally.
- Evaluate HR metrics and other departmental results in relation to established goals, and recommend new approaches, policies, and procedures to affect continual improvements in efficiency of department and services performed.

- Oversee the primary activities of HR Senior Managers to ensure completion of tasks and attainment of departmental goals.

- Responsible for goal planning and budgeting of each department's expenses.

- Model total development and provide leadership opportunities for direct reports.
Implement leadership development and training in a multi-location environment.
- Responsible for all HR responsibilities of direct and indirect reports (e.
g. hiring, coaching, training, appraising, etc.).
- Responsible for acting as a consultant to influence business partners, deliver constructive advice, diagnose and resolve problems and positively influence change.

- Knowledge of human resource policies, procedures, including development and delivery

- Analytical skills, with strengths in data analysis and presentation

- Ability to identify trends and develop appropriate recommendations for resolution

- Ability to present data, discuss issues, challenge, and negotiate with all levels of management

- Ability to work with and lead others, provide training and guidance as necessary

- Ability to work well with others, use productive work methods, exercise sound judgment, and display initiative and innovation on the job

- Knowledge and experience in Union Avoidance laws and techniques

- Knowledge of performance review, assessment, positive reinforcement, and rewards

- Personal computer and program proficiency including design, database, and word processing programs

- Strong knowledge of all relevant employment laws and regulations (wage and hour, FLSA, Title VII, FMLA, ADA, workers' comp, and other DOL regulations)

- Bachelor's degree in human resources, business or a related field required.
Advanced degree preferred. At least 5-7 years of progressive human resources experience, with management experience required. An appropriate combination of education and experience may be substituted.

jobs.title: Senior HR Manager – DC (San Antonio)
jobs.description:
﻿

The HR Senior Manager partners with Director Supply Chain Human Resources as part of a broader team responsible for all aspects of human resources in the Fresh facilities. Provides professional consultation in areas related to recruiting, talent assessment, retention initiatives, and training. Assists the Director Supply Chain Human Resources in the management of human capital strategy and metrics. This role will lead full life-cycle recruitment efforts for hourly and exempt roles, including creating and executing sourcing strategies and leading the team of HR Business Partners towards execution of human capital metrics.

Job Responsibility
• Leads and develops a high-performance team of HR Business Partners. (25%)
• Creates and maintains a market specific knowledge base that supplies the talent needs of the business model (hourly and exempt positions). (20%)
• Responsible for the creation and execution of retention strategies that promotes employee engagement, delivers workforce stability and achieves retention goals. (15%)
• Manages the employee relations process in partnership with aligned store support center resources. (15%)
• Responsible for maintaining open door policy and an environment free of organized labor through effective positive employee relations. (15%)
• Responsible for developing and maintaining a strategic partnership with Director and Assistant Directors in all buildings. (10%)

Job Qualifications
• Experience conducting full life cycle recruiting across multiple locations.
• Extensive knowledge of state and federal employment laws.
• Ability to mediate between employees during conflict resolution.
• Ability to achieve measurable results through collaboration and influence.
• Exceptional planning, coordination, project management and implementation skills.
• Advanced ability to communicate with employees at all levels (both verbal and written communication skills).
• Proficient in creating and presenting compelling content to diverse audiences.
• Extensive knowledge of employee relations practices and investigation skills for employee relations cases.

Working Conditions
• Work is conducted in a remote office setting.
• Up to 50% travel required to buildings and partnership locations.

Education/Experience
• BS/BA in Business Administration, Human Resources or applicable training in these areas with another degree; equivalent work experience may be substituted for degree.
• Proven track record of recruiting within an organization.
• Minimum of 3 years of experience with at least 2 years of recruiting.
• Strong sourcing background with experience filling roles in a scarce job market.
• Three to five years’ experience in benefits, employee relations, or as a human resources generalist.
• Ability to develop relationships and effectively influence with key stakeholders and candidates.
• Excellent teamwork and collaboration skills including strong communication skills.


Collaborates with the Director of Supply Chain Human Resources as part of a team overseeing all HR functions within Fresh facilities. This role provides expertise in recruiting, talent assessment, retention, and training, while leading full life-cycle recruitment for hourly and exempt roles and guiding HR Business Partners in executing human capital strategies and metrics.

- Employee Relations � Coordinates and conducts orientation and onboarding program for new hires.

Monitors supervisor compliance to record management requirements. Audits human resources records to insure data integrity. Maintains leaves of absences at the local level in partnership with third party and Store Support Center (SSC) staff. Prepares witness documentation and testifies at unemployment hearings. Manages facility certification programs for hourly and salaried employees, to include Performance Management, learning plans and Biz Library participation. Takes lead in preparing and training staff on special projects and pilot programs.
- Compliance � Monitors and recommends actions to comply with state and Federal employment law and Company policy.
Provides orientation to new employees regarding required compliance. Maintains employment posters in compliance.
- Safety - Active on safety team and participates in accident reviews.
Monitors compliance of reporting requirements and makes recommendations for corrective actions.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:
- Thorough knowledge of human resource principles and practices including positive employee relations, hiring, training, performance management, and employment law

- Ability to build effective working relationships at all levels of an organization

- Skills in researching for legal compliance and analytic ability to formulate best practices

- Effective oral and written communication skills, and ability to effectively present reports to management

- Computers skills: Word, Excel, Access, Outlook and HRIS such as Lawson, KRONOS and Sharepoint

WORK EXPERIENCE AND/OR EDUCATION:

- Knowledge and skill are normally acquired through post-secondary education at the bachelor's level in areas such as human resources management, industrial psychology and business administration.

- Professional human resources certification (or demonstrated progress towards certification) preferred but not required.

jobs.title: LEAD SALES ASSOCIATE-FT in ALLIANCE OH S21086
jobs.description:
Job Details General Summary:

Function as a Cashier and/or Stocker and act in a lead capacity in the absence of the Store Manager or Assistant Store Manager. Assist in setting and maintaining plan-o-grams and programs. Provide exemplary customer service. Perform other duties as necessary to maximize profitability, customer satisfaction, and teamwork, while protecting company assets and reducing losses.

Duties and Essential Job Functions

- Unload trucks according to the prescribed process for the store.

- Follow company work processes to receive, open and unpack cartons and totes.

- Stock merchandise; rotate and face merchandise on shelves and build merchandise displays.

- Restock returned and recovered merchandise.

- Order zones and drop shipment categories, following prescribed ordering practices, as assigned by the Store Manager.

- Assist in plan-o-gram implementation and maintenance.

- Assist customers by locating merchandise.

- Bail cardboard and take out trash; dust and mop store floors; clean restroom and stockroom.

- Greet customers as they enter the store.

- Maintain register countertops and bags; implement register countertop plan-o-grams.

- Operate cash register and flatbed scanner to itemize and total customer's purchase; bag merchandise.

- Collect payment from customer and make change.

- Clean front end of store and help set up sidewalk displays.

- Help to maintain a clean, well-organized store and facilitate a safe and secure working and shopping environment.

- Provide superior customer service leadership.

- Follow company policies and procedures as outlined in the Standard Operating Procedures manual, Employee Handbook, and company communications.

- Open and/or close the store under specific direction of the Area Manager.

In the Absence of the Store Manager or Assistant Store Manager:
- Authorize and sign for refunds and overrides; count register; make bank deposits.

- Assist in maintaining strict cashier accountability, key control, and adherence to company security practices and cash control procedures.

- Monitor cash levels and make appropriate drawer pulls as directed by the Store Manager.

- Monitor cameras for unusual activities (customers and employees), if applicable.

- Supply cashiers with change when needed.

- Complete all required paperwork and documentation according to guidelines and deadlines as assigned.

Job Qualifications

Knowledge and Skills

- Ability to perform mathematical calculations such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and percentages.

- Knowledge of cash handling procedures including cashier accountability and deposit control.

- Ability to perform IBM cash register functions.

- Knowledge of cash, facility and safety control policies and practices.

- Effective interpersonal and oral & written communication skills.

- Understanding of safety policies and practices.

- Ability to read and follow plan-o-gram and merchandise presentation guidance.

Work Experience and/or Education

- High school diploma or equivalent and six months of supervisory experience (or related experience/training) preferred.

Working Conditions

- Frequent walking and standing

- Frequent bending, stooping, and kneeling to run check out station, stock merchandise and unload trucks; which may also require the ability to push and/or pull rolltainers for stocking merchandise

- Frequent handling of merchandise and equipment such as handheld scanners, pricing guns, box cutters, merchandise containers, two-wheel dollies, U-boats (six-wheel carts), and rolltainers

- Frequent and proper lifting of up to 40 pounds; occasional lifting of up to 55 pounds

- Occasional climbing (using step ladder) up to heights of six feet

- Fast-paced environment; moderate noise level

- Occasional exposure to outside weather conditions

- Occasional or regular driving/providing own transportation to make bank deposits, attend management meetings and travel to other Dollar General stores.
Relocation assistance is not available for this position. Dollar General Corporation is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: LEAD SALES ASSOCIATE-FT in ALLIANCE NE S07534
jobs.description:
Job Details General Summary:

The Lead Sales Associate helps maintain a clean, well-organized store with a customer-first focus. The duties of the Lead Sales Associate include assisting customers in locating and purchasing merchandise, operating a cash register, stocking and recovering merchandise, cleaning the store, and performing other duties as assigned by the Store Manager to maximize store profitability and customer satisfaction while protecting company assets. Lead Sales Associates perform the duties of a Sales Associate and act in a lead capacity in the absence of the Store Manager or Assistant Store Manager.

Duties and Essential Job Functions
- Provide superior customer service leadership; greet and assist customers.

- Operate cash register and scanner to itemize and total customer's purchase, collect payment from customers and make change, bag merchandise, and assist customers with merchandise as necessary.

- Follow company work processes to receive, open and unpack boxes, cartons and totes of merchandise; stock merchandise, restock and rotate merchandise on shelves, and build merchandise displays.

- Clean the store; take out trash; dust and mop store floors; clean restroom and stockroom; and help set up sidewalk displays.

- Assist in implementation and maintenance of planograms.

- Open and close the store under specific direction of the Store Manager.

- Perform additional duties typically performed by the Store Manager or Assistant Store Manager, in their absence.

Job Qualifications

Knowledge and Skills

- Effective interpersonal and oral communication skills.

- Understanding of safety policies and practices.

- Ability to read and follow planogram and merchandise presentation guides.

- Ability to perform mathematical calculations such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and percentages.

- Ability to perform cash register functions.

- Knowledge of cash, facility, and safety control policies and practices.

- Knowledge of cash handling procedures including cashier accountability and deposit control.

- Ability to drive own vehicle to the bank to deposit money.

WORK EXPERIENCE and/or EDUCATION

High school diploma or equivalent and six months of supervisory experience (or related experience/training) preferred.

Working Conditions

- Frequent walking and standing

- Frequent bending, stooping, and kneeling to run check out station, stock merchandise and unload trucks; which may also require the ability to push and/or pull rolltainers for stocking merchandise

- Frequent handling of merchandise and equipment such as handheld scanners, pricing guns, box cutters, merchandise containers, two-wheel dollies, U-boats (six-wheel carts), and rolltainers

- Frequent and proper lifting of up to 40 pounds; occasional lifting of up to 55 pounds

- Occasional climbing (using step ladder) up to heights of six feet

- Fast-paced environment; moderate noise level

- Occasional exposure to outside weather conditions

- Occasional or regular driving/providing own transportation to make bank deposits, attend management meetings and travel to other Dollar General stores.

Dollar General Corporation is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: LEAD SALES ASSOCIATE-FT in CRESAPTOWN MD S04842
jobs.description:
Job Details General Summary:

The Lead Sales Associate helps maintain a clean, well-organized store with a customer-first focus. The duties of the Lead Sales Associate include assisting customers in locating and purchasing merchandise, operating a cash register, stocking and recovering merchandise, cleaning the store, and performing other duties as assigned by the Store Manager to maximize store profitability and customer satisfaction while protecting company assets. Lead Sales Associates perform the duties of a Sales Associate and act in a lead capacity in the absence of the Store Manager or Assistant Store Manager.

Duties and Essential Job Functions
- Provide superior customer service leadership; greet and assist customers.

- Operate cash register and scanner to itemize and total customer's purchase, collect payment from customers and make change, bag merchandise, and assist customers with merchandise as necessary.

- Follow company work processes to receive, open and unpack boxes, cartons and totes of merchandise; stock merchandise, restock and rotate merchandise on shelves, and build merchandise displays.

- Clean the store; take out trash; dust and mop store floors; clean restroom and stockroom; and help set up sidewalk displays.

- Assist in implementation and maintenance of planograms.

- Open and close the store under specific direction of the Store Manager.

- Perform additional duties typically performed by the Store Manager or Assistant Store Manager, in their absence.

Job Qualifications

Knowledge and Skills

- Effective interpersonal and oral communication skills.

- Understanding of safety policies and practices.

- Ability to read and follow planogram and merchandise presentation guides.

- Ability to perform mathematical calculations such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and percentages.

- Ability to perform cash register functions.

- Knowledge of cash, facility, and safety control policies and practices.

- Knowledge of cash handling procedures including cashier accountability and deposit control.

- Ability to drive own vehicle to the bank to deposit money.

Work Experience and/or Education

High school diploma or equivalent and six months of supervisory experience (or related experience/training) preferred.

Working Conditions

- Frequent walking and standing

- Frequent bending, stooping, and kneeling to run check out station, stock merchandise and unload trucks; which may also require the ability to push and/or pull rolltainers for stocking merchandise

- Frequent handling of merchandise and equipment such as handheld scanners, pricing guns, box cutters, merchandise containers, two-wheel dollies, U-boats (six-wheel carts), and rolltainers

- Frequent and proper lifting of up to 40 pounds; occasional lifting of up to 55 pounds

- Occasional climbing (using step ladder) up to heights of six feet

- Fast-paced environment; moderate noise level

- Occasional exposure to outside weather conditions

- Occasional or regular driving/providing own transportation to make bank deposits, attend management meetings and travel to other Dollar General stores.

Dollar General Corporation is an equal opportunity employer.
